metadata.title: When you accidentally land the ONLY kill and enemy rage quits instantly in VALORANT
metadata.description:
That one kill that should’ve been a whiff but somehow hit.
Watch me confuse myself and the enemy at the same time.
Valorant logic: how did this even work?

Remember when aim was optional? Yeah, me neither.

Hit like if your aim has ever ghosted but the kill still showed up!

#valorant #gaming #funnyclips #luckykill #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
